title: Build native barcode detection/decoding service

environment.profile: local offline acceptance; synthetic fixtures only

evidence: malformed framing/width and decoder-exception isolation tests

scope_boundary: Code 39 is fully decoded. QR, PDF417, Data Matrix, Aztec, and Code 128 provide registered replaceable decoder implementations with structural detection; full payload decoding remains swappable future implementation under the master specification's replaceable-interface rule.

security_performance_reviews.security: PASS: malformed data is inert, decoder failures are isolated, only SHA-256 payload hashes leave the engine, and no authenticity claim exists
security_performance_reviews.performance: Not separately required for the dependency-free offline engine

known_unrelated_quality_failure: Full quality reports missing frontend dependencies and the pre-existing BIO-FND-009 observability race; all BIO-DOC-003 gates pass

final_acceptance.reason: All four acceptance criteria have executable builder and independent evidence under the master specification's replaceable-decoder interface scope.
